price_why: The sampler board, the three-consistency post and the three-borders post are concrete carousels a home-baking piping creator could shoot this week, and the brief comes with trend context. Two of the five picks are underdeveloped and one section is empty, so it isn't worth $49.
one_line: A sourced trend brief for a vintage/Lambeth cake decorator that borrows layouts from embroidery samplers and sewing-pattern envelopes to produce five ranked post ideas, three of them close to ready to shoot.
strongest: The Lambeth sampler board: a flat reference board anyone can save, with the cover, slide order, hook and 'would fail if' condition all settled.
weakest: Picks 4 and 5 (the butter-yellow heart and the sculpted-object frame) have no settled format, cover or hook, and section 2 delivers nothing usable.
